claims: Carlos Boozer is an American former professional basketball player of Black ethnicity.
Carlos Boozer was born on a U.S. military base in Aschaffenburg, West Germany.
Carlos Boozer was born to American parents.
Carlos Boozer was raised primarily in Juneau, Alaska.
Carlos Boozer often discussed growing up in a predominantly white community in Alaska.
Carlos Boozer has noted the importance of his Black heritage in his memoir and interviews
